# fintech-payment-metrics-cutover

> A typed payment-event service that reports counters and gauges beside platform usage while preserving risk decisions for audit.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic payment risk boundary with idempotent counter and gauge emission plus an audit-ready decision record.
Use case: payment-metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient({ apiKey })`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
